title: Open-Turn Doc Correction Audit
architecture_upgrade: Adds a correction note distinguishing direct W33 open turns from complement-dual one-edge triples.
key_points: Direct W33 open dynamics uses oriented two-edge triples in W33.
One-edge triples in W33 are the complement-dual partner.
The count 2 * 2160 = 4320 explains direct W33 open turns.
The architecture docs now keep direct Hashimoto dynamics separate from complement-dual parity dynamics.
